name: Lumisan
source:
A month has passed since the untimely death of Emilio's older sister, thirty days of grief and denial, he had spent his days stuck in a past he has no power to change.

That is, until a familiar face pays him a visit one mundane afternoon, he starts to consider that maybe, things aren't as permanent as they seem to be.

[From [url=https://louisianthus.itch.io/lumisan-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
埃米利奥的姐姐英年早逝已经一个月了，三十天的悲伤和否认，他一直沉浸在自己无力改变的过去中。

也就是说，直到一个熟悉的面孔在一个平凡的下午拜访他，他开始考虑，也许事情并不像看起来那么永久。

[来自[url=https://louisianthus.itch.io/lumisan-demo]itch.io[/url]]
